title: U.S. Weekly Gas Prices
text:
Retrieved from TidyTuesday: https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2025/2025-07-01
The data is originally from the U.S. Energy Information Adminitrastion (EIA)
This week we’re exploring weekly US gas prices! The data comes from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), which publishes average retail gasoline and diesel prices each Monday. The original data (including additional datasets) can be found at eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel, and the weekly time series used here was downloaded from this XLS file.
Prices over time basic comparison


Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=fuel)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(title = "Fuel Price Overtime")











Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=fuel)) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~fuel) + 
  labs(title = "Fuel Price Overtime by Fuel")









Prices by Grade (ALL)


Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~grade) +
  labs( title = "Price by Grade")











Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(~grade) + 
  labs(title = "Price by Grade")









Prices by Fuel Type and Grade


Code
weekly_gas |> 
  filter(fuel == "gasoline") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(title = "Prices for Gasoline")











Code
weekly_gas|> 
  filter(fuel == "diesel") |> 
  ggplot( aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(title = "Prices for Diesel")









Prices by Formulation of Gasoline


Code
weekly_gas |> 
  filter(fuel == "gasoline") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=price, color=formulation)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(
    title = "Prices by Formulation", x = "Date", y= "Price",  color = "Formulation" )









Volatility/Price distribution


Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=price, color = fuel)) +
    geom_histogram() + 
    labs(title = "Distribution of Price Changes by Fuel")


`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.











Code
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=price, color = grade)) +
    geom_boxplot() + 
    facet_wrap(~fuel) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Price Changes by Grade")
